name: auto-bookmarks
description: Automatically find configured text markers and navigate grouped occurrences from the Activity Bar.

viewsWelcome.contents:
No bookmarks found in the active file.
[Open Settings](command:autoBookmarks.openSettings)
[Refresh](command:autoBookmarks.refresh)

autoBookmarks.searchTexts.description: Deprecated. Moved into autoBookmarks.documentationLinks (text, color, url); existing values are migrated automatically.

autoBookmarks.fileTypes.description: Extensions to scan. Empty means all file types.

autoBookmarks.colors.description: Deprecated. Colors are now set per entry in autoBookmarks.documentationLinks; existing values are migrated automatically.

autoBookmarks.maxFileSizeMB.description: Maximum file size in MB that Auto Bookmarks will scan. Set to 0 to disable the limit.

autoBookmarks.documentationLinks.description: Bookmarks: text to find in the active file, an optional highlight color and an optional documentation URL. Set "active": false to stop searching for an entry without deleting it. Entries with an http(s) URL also show an "Open Documentation" lightbulb when the cursor is on an exact match.

text.description: Text to find (exact, whole word for the documentation lightbulb).

active.description: Only active entries are searched. Inactive entries stay saved but create no bookmarks or highlights. Missing means true.

color.description: Highlight color (for example #38bdf8) for the gutter next to the line number of matching lines and for the overview ruler.

url.description: Optional http(s) documentation URL opened by the Quick Fix.

enumDescriptions: A colored bar on the left edge of the line, right next to the gutter. The gutter stays free, so VS Code's lightbulb for documentation links is shown there together with the color.

A colored strip in the gutter next to the line number. On the line where the documentation lightbulb is about to show (cursor on a link text) the strip hides, because VS Code cannot show both in the gutter.
autoBookmarks.highlightStyle.description: Where the bookmark color is drawn. The overview ruler always uses the color too.
